answer: I ran a 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. I sent it with qiskit through IQMProvider and transpiled it for the backend. The job ID is 01a15f3a-d015-7403-9eed-16eb690bfe69. The counts were {"000": 200}. A real device would split the shots between 000 and 111. The mock backend does not simulate the circuit. It returns placeholder results, so every shot came back as 000. This job used no credits. The script is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-34/run_ghz.py.
